responsibility: This header declares helper routines for DATA statement resolution and initialization assignment. It exposes entry points for assigning DATA values, computing and advancing array-section indices, and normalizing a symbol’s resulting initializer after DATA processing.
same_name_distinction: Exposes the small API used by other front-end code to assign DATA values, walk section indices, and formalize resulting initializers. Unlike gcc/fortran/data.cc, it does not implement DATA semantics itself.
